verifications.rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (33 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kid_A_Mnesia, https://www.discogs.com/release/20924998-Radiohead-Kid-A-Mnesia?redirected=true. Official 21st-anniversary reissue (Nov 5, 2021, XL Recordings), 3xCD. Disc 1 = Kid A (10), Disc 2 = Amnesiac (11), Disc 3 = Kid Amnesiae (12 previously unreleased/alternate tracks). Digital edition splits 'Motion Picture Soundtrack' and its hidden 'Untitled' track into 34 tracks.
